segments.text: Settling things like hazardous chemicals or specimens requires a great deal of caution.
segments.zh: 处理危险化学品或样本之类的东西，需要格外谨慎。

segments.text: If we don't contain them, hazards can spread and contaminate the things around them, including
segments.zh: 如果我们不把它们控制住，危害就会扩散，污染周围的东西，包括

segments.text: you and your co-workers.
segments.zh: 你和你的同事。

segments.text: Every day we're called on to handle substances like toxins, corrosives, and carcinogens.
segments.zh: 我们每天都要处理毒物、腐蚀性物质和致癌物之类的物质。

segments.text: We think we know how to protect ourselves, but are we doing all we can?
segments.zh: 我们以为自己知道如何保护自己，但我们真的做到了一切能做的吗？

segments.text: Having tiny amounts of a hazardous material combined with a few unconscious actions can
segments.zh: 极少量的危险物质，再加上几个无意识的动作，就可能

segments.text: spread contamination.
segments.zh: 使污染扩散。

segments.text: Let's take a closer look.
segments.zh: 我们来仔细看一看。

segments.text: The luminescent dye that's been added to this material makes it easy to trace the path of
segments.zh: 这种物质中加入了荧光染料，便于追踪

segments.text: any contamination.
segments.zh: 任何污染的路径。

segments.text: As we can see, the dye has been spread from the liquid on the outside of the test tube
segments.zh: 我们可以看到，染料从试管外壁的液体上

segments.text: to the lab worker themself, and can then be transferred to everything they touch.
segments.zh: 扩散到了实验人员身上，然后又会被转移到他们碰到的所有东西上。

segments.text: When it's this easy for contamination to occur, we need to do everything we can to prevent
segments.zh: 既然污染这么容易发生，我们就需要尽一切努力去防止

segments.text: it.
segments.zh: 它。

segments.text: This means being very careful with the products we work with and how we handle them.
segments.zh: 这意味着要非常小心我们所使用的产品以及我们处理它们的方式。

segments.text: To effectively shield ourselves from contamination, we need to first know about the materials we're
segments.zh: 要有效地保护自己免受污染，我们首先需要了解我们

segments.text: working with.
segments.zh: 所使用的物质。

segments.text: So you need to read product labels and safety data sheets before starting to use a substance.
segments.zh: 所以在开始使用一种物质之前，你需要阅读产品标签和安全技术说明书。

segments.text: These and other references describe the potential hazards presented by the material, and they
segments.zh: 这些以及其他参考资料描述了该物质可能带来的危害，还

segments.text: tell us how to protect ourselves from contamination.
segments.zh: 告诉我们如何保护自己免受污染。

segments.text: As we think about protecting ourselves, we need to consider the four major roots of
segments.zh: 在考虑如何保护自己时，我们需要考虑物质进入人体的四种主要

segments.text: entry a material has to our bodies – inhalation, eye contact, skin contact, absorption and
segments.zh: 途径——吸入、眼睛接触、皮肤接触、吸收和

segments.text: injection, and ingestion.
segments.zh: 注射，以及食入。

segments.text: We can guard these roots of entry by using a combination of personal protective equipment
segments.zh: 我们可以结合使用个人防护装备

segments.text: PPE, engineering controls, and safe work practices.
segments.zh: PPE、工程控制和安全作业规范来守住这些进入途径。

segments.text: Let's start with personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 我们先从个人防护装备说起。

segments.text: It needs to be inspected before you put it on.
segments.zh: 在穿戴之前需要对它进行检查。

segments.text: Replace any items that are ripped or otherwise damaged, and make sure you've got a proper
segments.zh: 更换任何撕破或有其他损坏的物品，并确保尺寸

segments.text: fit.
segments.zh: 合身。

segments.text: At a minimum, you should wear gloves, a lab coat, and safety eyewear.
segments.zh: 至少你应该戴手套、穿实验服、戴安全护目镜。

segments.text: Some operations demand even more protection.
segments.zh: 有些操作还要求更多的防护。

segments.text: For instance, face shields should be worn if there's a danger of chemical splashes
segments.zh: 例如，如果有化学品溅到头部、面部和颈部的危险，

segments.text: to the head, face, and neck area.
segments.zh: 就应该戴面罩。

segments.text: You need to anticipate the hazards associated with the materials you're working with,
segments.zh: 你需要预见到与你所用物质相关的危害，

segments.text: and talk to your supervisor to make sure that you're using all the PPE that you need
segments.zh: 并和你的主管沟通，确保你使用了所有需要的个人防护装备，

segments.text: to be fully protected.
segments.zh: 从而得到充分保护。

segments.text: You should also monitor the condition of your protective equipment throughout the day,
segments.zh: 你还应该在一天中随时留意防护装备的状况，

segments.text: and immediately replace anything that's damaged or that may have become contaminated.
segments.zh: 一旦有任何东西损坏或可能已被污染，立即更换。

segments.text: Pay special attention to your gloves.
segments.zh: 要特别注意你的手套。

segments.text: Perspiration on the inside and other liquids on the outside can make gloves permeable
segments.zh: 手套内侧的汗液和外侧的其他液体，会使手套变得可渗透，

segments.text: to the very thing you're trying to prevent – contamination.
segments.zh: 恰恰让你想要防止的东西——污染——透过来。

segments.text: Change your gloves at least once every two hours, or as soon as they become wet.
segments.zh: 至少每两小时更换一次手套，或者手套一湿就立即更换。

segments.text: You should also look at how you can use engineering controls to protect against contamination
segments.zh: 你还应该考虑如何利用工程控制来防止污染，

segments.text: when you're working with hazardous materials.
segments.zh: 在你处理危险物质的时候。

segments.text: Equipment like splash guards and blast shields can protect your skin and eyes from inadvertent
segments.zh: 防溅挡板和防爆护罩之类的设备，可以保护你的皮肤和眼睛，避免意外

segments.text: chemical contact.
segments.zh: 接触化学品。

segments.text: Exhaust hoods and other ventilation devices will keep contaminated fumes and vapors out
segments.zh: 排风罩和其他通风装置能让受污染的烟气和蒸气远离

segments.text: of your breathing zone.
segments.zh: 你的呼吸区。

segments.text: Consult your supervisor about the engineering controls you can use in your lab to limit
segments.zh: 向你的主管咨询，在你的实验室里可以使用哪些工程控制来限制

segments.text: the spread of contamination.
segments.zh: 污染的扩散。

segments.text: Even with the proper PPE and engineering controls, contamination can still occur if
segments.zh: 即使有合适的个人防护装备和工程控制，如果

segments.text: you don't follow safe work practices.
segments.zh: 你不遵守安全作业规范，污染仍然可能发生。

segments.text: To start, this means paying attention to good housekeeping.
segments.zh: 首先，这意味着要注意保持良好的内务整洁。

segments.text: Keep your work area neat and orderly.
segments.zh: 让你的工作区域整齐有序，

segments.text: Avoid unnecessary clutter.
segments.zh: 避免不必要的杂乱。

segments.text: Wherever possible, use small containers.
segments.zh: 只要有可能，就使用小容器。

segments.text: And if you're not using a substance, put it back where it belongs.
segments.zh: 如果你不用某种物质了，就把它放回原处。

segments.text: Any spill should be cleaned up as quickly as possible.
segments.zh: 任何溅洒都应尽快清理干净。

segments.text: Follow proper disposal procedures and decontaminate the spill area.
segments.zh: 遵守正确的处置程序，并对溅洒区域进行去污。

segments.text: When you're finished with a piece of equipment, make sure that it's cleaned up and decontaminated
segments.zh: 用完一件设备后，要确保把它清理干净并去污，

segments.text: before you leave for the day.
segments.zh: 然后再下班离开。

segments.text: You don't know who might need to use it later.
segments.zh: 你不知道之后谁可能需要用它。

segments.text: If you can't clean glassware immediately, soak it in soap and water.
segments.zh: 如果你不能立即清洗玻璃仪器，就把它浸泡在肥皂水中。

segments.text: This will cut down on contamination and make cleanup easier.
segments.zh: 这样可以减少污染，也让清洗更容易。

segments.text: You should plan for the disposal of hazardous or infectious waste before you begin a procedure.
segments.zh: 在开始一项操作之前，你就应该计划好危险废物或感染性废物的处置。

segments.text: Your lab has a written policy on handling this type of waste, so follow it.
segments.zh: 你的实验室有处理这类废物的书面规定，所以要遵照执行。

segments.text: Be careful what you pour down the drain.
segments.zh: 小心你往下水道里倒的东西。

segments.text: The sewer system is not built to handle laboratory chemicals.
segments.zh: 排水系统并不是为处理实验室化学品而建的。

segments.text: A mistake in disposal could contaminate the local supply of drinking water and other parts
segments.zh: 处置上的失误可能会污染当地的饮用水供应以及环境中的

segments.text: of the environment.
segments.zh: 其他部分。

segments.text: Ask your supervisor or safety officer about your lab's disposal procedures.
segments.zh: 向你的主管或安全员询问你们实验室的处置程序。

segments.text: Another problem with contamination is its potential for personal transportation.
segments.zh: 污染的另一个问题是，它可能会被人随身带走。

segments.text: When you're on a break, off to lunch, or on your way home, it can be easy to take a
segments.zh: 当你休息、去吃午饭或者下班回家时，很容易把

segments.text: contaminant with you.
segments.zh: 污染物随身带走。

segments.text: Leave notebooks, pencils, and other supplies in the lab.
segments.zh: 把笔记本、铅笔和其他用品留在实验室里。

segments.text: Anything you use in your work should be thought of as being contaminated.
segments.zh: 你工作中用到的任何东西都应被视为已受污染。

segments.text: Wash your hands thoroughly before leaving your work area.
segments.zh: 离开工作区域前要彻底洗手。

segments.text: Never wear your PPE or lab coat outside the lab.
segments.zh: 绝不要穿戴个人防护装备或实验服走出实验室。

segments.text: That can cause real problems.
segments.zh: 那会造成真正的问题。

segments.text: For instance, gloves can leave contaminants on doorknobs, which in turn can contaminate
segments.zh: 例如，手套会把污染物留在门把手上，进而又会污染

segments.text: the next person coming through the door.
segments.zh: 下一个进门的人。

segments.text: Poor safety practices can also increase the risk of ingesting hazardous materials.
segments.zh: 不良的安全习惯还会增加食入危险物质的风险。

segments.text: Something as simple as taking your lab notebook to lunch could lead to contaminating your
segments.zh: 像把实验记录本带去吃午饭这样简单的事情，就可能导致你的

segments.text: sandwich.
segments.zh: 三明治受到污染。

segments.text: Of course, this type of problem can also occur inside the lab.
segments.zh: 当然，这类问题在实验室里面也可能发生。

segments.text: Never bring food or drink into your lab area.
segments.zh: 绝不要把食物或饮料带进实验室区域。

segments.text: Don't wash your coffee cup or lunch dishes in the lab sink.
segments.zh: 不要在实验室水槽里清洗你的咖啡杯或午餐餐具。

segments.text: The rule of thumb for avoiding ingestion hazards is never mix contaminants with uncontaminated
segments.zh: 避免食入危害的经验法则是：绝不要让污染物与未受污染的

segments.text: objects or areas.
segments.zh: 物品或区域混在一起。

segments.text: You also need to remember that contaminants move easily from one part of your body to
segments.zh: 你还要记住，污染物很容易从身体的一个部位转移到

segments.text: another.
segments.zh: 另一个部位。

segments.text: So you should avoid nervous habits like rubbing your face or scratching your nose.
segments.zh: 所以你应该避免揉脸或挠鼻子之类的紧张小动作，

segments.text: They can bring hazards too close to your mouth.
segments.zh: 它们会把危害带到离你嘴巴太近的地方。

segments.text: It's also important to protect the materials that you're working with from contamination.
segments.zh: 保护你所使用的材料免受污染也很重要。

segments.text: It's all too easy to contaminate a sample with a chemical unknown that can result in
segments.zh: 样品很容易被某种未知化学物质污染，从而导致

segments.text: a false reading.
segments.zh: 错误的读数。

segments.text: To prevent the contamination of samples and other materials, keep your work surfaces and
segments.zh: 为防止样品和其他材料受到污染，要保持你的工作台面和

segments.text: equipment clean.
segments.zh: 设备清洁。

segments.text: Check them before, during, and after your work.
segments.zh: 在工作之前、期间和之后都要检查它们。

segments.text: Decontaminate all the equipment after using it.
segments.zh: 使用后对所有设备进行去污。

segments.text: Be thorough.
segments.zh: 要彻底。

segments.text: Follow your lab's established cleaning procedures.
segments.zh: 遵守你们实验室既定的清洁程序。

segments.text: Pay special attention to equipment that's shared with other workers.
segments.zh: 要特别注意与其他人员共用的设备。

segments.text: Hot plates and stirrers, for example, tend to collect chemical residues over time.
segments.zh: 比如加热板和搅拌器，时间一长往往会积聚化学残留物。

segments.text: These residues can then contaminate the work that you're doing.
segments.zh: 这些残留物进而会污染你正在做的工作。

segments.text: When cleaning equipment or your lab area, make sure to use appropriate cleaning methods.
segments.zh: 清洁设备或实验室区域时，一定要使用合适的清洁方法。

segments.text: Don't use air guns to blow away powder.
segments.zh: 不要用气枪吹走粉末，

segments.text: It could easily contaminate other areas and employees.
segments.zh: 那很容易污染其他区域和人员。

segments.text: Simply blot or sweep up the powder with a dry paper towel and dispose of it properly.
segments.zh: 只需用干纸巾把粉末吸干或扫起来，并妥善处置。

segments.text: Keeping things free from contamination is critical to safe and productive lab operations.
segments.zh: 使物品免受污染，对于实验室安全而高效地运行至关重要。

segments.text: Let's review.
segments.zh: 我们来回顾一下。

segments.text: Know what materials you're dealing with.
segments.zh: 了解你所处理的是什么物质，

segments.text: Don't make assumptions.
segments.zh: 不要想当然。

segments.text: Wear PPE and dispose of it properly when you're finished.
segments.zh: 穿戴个人防护装备，用完后妥善处置。

segments.text: Use the correct engineering controls for the work that you're doing.
segments.zh: 针对你所做的工作使用正确的工程控制。

segments.text: Maintain good housekeeping practices.
segments.zh: 保持良好的内务整洁习惯，

segments.text: And work carefully.
segments.zh: 并且小心操作。

segments.text: Be aware of the substances and equipment you come into contact with.
segments.zh: 留意你接触到的物质和设备。

segments.text: Most importantly, remember that the best way to prevent contamination is to be mindful of
segments.zh: 最重要的是，记住防止污染的最好方法，是心里想着

segments.text: those who worked before you and considerate of those who will work after you.
segments.zh: 在你之前工作过的人，并替在你之后工作的人着想。
